svg.title: ESP32 wiring diagram
svg.desc: An ESP32 dev board in the centre, wired to an INMP441 microphone and a VS1838B infrared receiver on the left, an SSD1306 OLED and a 7-LED NeoPixel jewel on the right, with a shared 5 volt and ground rail below feeding pogo pin stacking contacts.
svg.text: joined — lines that merely cross are not connected
